findings.summary: Activating the itemized-balances link scrolls to a heading that cannot receive focus, so keyboard focus may remain at the link.
findings.fix: Add tabindex="-1" to the Fee balances heading so fragment navigation can move focus there; provide a visible focus style if needed.

passed: The summary link is a native anchor with a valid matching target and is keyboard reachable.
When fee rows exist, the horizontally scrollable table wrapper is keyboard reachable with tabindex="0" and has a visible focus outline.
The fee table uses native table markup with scoped column and row headers.
